title: Release Train Engineer
description:
About This Role
**5 years of experience**  

**Skills: SAFe 5, RTE, PI Planning, ART Sync, Stakeholder Engagement, Agile, Banking, Capital Markets, DevOps, Jira/confluence**

**About the Role** We are looking for an experienced Release Train Engineer (RTE) with 5\+ years of experience to lead and facilitate Agile Release Train (ART) delivery You will serve as a servant leader and coach for the ART — facilitating PI Planning, managing cross\-team dependencies, removing impediments, and driving continuous improvement across the delivery organisation. Banking and capital markets domain experience is essential for this role — enabling you to engage credibly with business stakeholders, understand regulatory delivery constraints, and navigate the governance frameworks of a complex financial services environment.


**Key Responsibilities**


ART Facilitation \& Delivery


* Facilitate and coordinate all ART\-level ceremonies — PI Planning, ART Sync, System Demos, and Inspect \& Adapt workshops — ensuring effective cross\-team alignment and programme increment delivery.
* Manage and coordinate delivery across two squads of 7 — ensuring teams are aligned to PI objectives, dependencies are managed, and risks are identified and mitigated proactively.
* Track and manage ART\-level programme board — maintaining visibility of features, dependencies, risks, and milestones across both squads throughout each programme increment.
* Facilitate cross\-team dependency resolution — identifying blockers, coordinating between squads, and escalating impediments that cannot be resolved at team level.
* Support squad\-level Scrum Masters — providing coaching, guidance, and facilitation support to ensure effective Agile ceremonies and team delivery rhythms.
* Monitor and report ART\-level delivery metrics — velocity, predictability, feature completion, and PI objective achievement — providing clear, evidence\-based progress updates to programme leadership.
* Coordinate System Demo preparation and execution — ensuring both squads deliver integrated, demonstrable working software at the end of each programme increment.

Continuous Improvement \& Coaching


* Lead Inspect \& Adapt workshops — facilitating structured retrospectives at ART level, identifying systemic improvement opportunities, and driving measurable delivery improvement.
* Coach squads, Product Owners, and stakeholders on SAFe principles, Agile practices, and continuous improvement mindset.
* Champion DevOps and continuous delivery practices — supporting squads in improving build, test, and deployment automation to accelerate feature delivery.
* Foster a culture of collaboration, transparency, and psychological safety across both squads — enabling high\-performing, self\-organising teams.

Stakeholder Management \& Governance


* Act as the primary ART\-level communication interface — providing regular, clear delivery status updates to programme managers, product leadership, and senior stakeholders.
* Manage relationships with Business Owners, Product Management, and key stakeholders — facilitating business engagement in PI Planning, System Demos, and governance forums.
* Contribute to portfolio\-level planning — providing ART capacity, dependency, and risk inputs to support programme and portfolio prioritisation decisions.
* Support risk and compliance governance — ensuring ART delivery activities align to organisational delivery standards, change management processes, and regulatory requirements within a banking and capital markets environment.
* Maintain ART\-level documentation — PI plans, programme boards, risk registers, and retrospective action logs.

**What We're Looking For**


* 5\+ years of experience in Agile delivery roles — Scrum Master, RTE, or Agile Coach — with at least 2–3 years as a Release Train Engineer in a SAFe environment.


* Deep SAFe expertise — PI Planning facilitation, ART coordination, programme board management, and Inspect \& Adapt — with proven ability to lead ARTs of 10–15\+ people.


* **Banking and capital markets domain experience — essential** — understanding of financial services delivery constraints, regulatory governance, and capital markets technology programmes.


* Experience managing cross\-team dependencies and delivery coordination across multiple squads in fast\-paced programme delivery environments.


* Strong servant leadership and coaching skills — supporting Scrum Masters, Product Owners, and squad members in Agile best practices.


* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills — engaging senior business and technology stakeholders with clear, concise ART\-level delivery reporting.


* Proficiency with Agile tooling — Jira, Confluence, Miro — for PI planning, programme board management, and delivery reporting.


* Strong facilitation skills — leading large\-group PI Planning events, System Demos, and Inspect \& Adapt workshops with energy, structure, and impact.


* Good understanding of DevOps and continuous delivery practices — supporting squads in improving automation and deployment frequency.


* Strong analytical mindset — interpreting ART delivery metrics and driving data\-informed continuous improvement.


**Nice to Have**


* SAFe Release Train Engineer (RTE) certification — SAFe 5 or SAFe 6\.
* SAFe Programme Consultant (SPC) certification.
* Experience in capital markets technology programmes — trade reporting, regulatory platforms, market data, or trading systems delivery.
* Familiarity with LPM (Lean Portfolio Management) and portfolio\-level Agile governance.
* Experience with scaled Agile tooling — Jira Align, Rally, or equivalent ART\-level planning tools.
* Agile coaching certification — ICP\-ACC or equivalent.
* Exposure to regulatory delivery programmes — MiFID II, EMIR, APRA, or equivalent financial services regulatory change.
